product_metadata.title: FINPAC Insulated Lunch Bag, Large Lunch Tote for Women Men Adult, Leakproof Reusable Instant Lunch Box Cooler Container with Front/Side Pockets for Work (Black)
features: 【Durable Material】This lunch tote bag made of 272T water-repellent oxford cloth, prevent rips and ensure maximum durability. The food-grade insulated interior is also easy to maintain and clean – simply wipe with a damp cloth to clean!
【Leakproof Insulated】Eco-friendly and non-toxic insulated lining with thick pearl cotton help keep food stay cold/warm/fresh for hours, the heat-welded seams to guard against leaks.

【Large Capacity】12.6" x 5.5" x 10.2" (L x W x H) Large enough for packing all the food and snacks for the entire day. The main compartment to keep your food and drinks cold or warm. The zippered front pocket for easy access like keys, cards and phone. Two side pockets for the water bottles.
【Multi-Use & Portable】Comes with a reinforced stitches handle, great choice to pack food and drinks for work, picnics, beach, road trips, camping, traveling or any outdoor activities.

【Stylish & Practical】This lunch bag sports a stylish design that never goes out of style, a perfect gift for women, men, adults on valentine’s day, birthday, Thanksgiving, Christmas or any other anniversary. (Bag Only! Other containers not included)
